results.title: 📢 Launching a new "GLB/D1 Power Pool Aug`26"
results.description:
🎉 Exciting news! We have launched a new "GLB/D1 Power Pool Aug`26" theme.
Duration: 27 July’26 - 9th August’26 (2 weeks)
Multiplier: 1X for regular power pool alphas.
Details:Power Pool Alpha must be on GLB region and delay "1" and universe "TOPDIV3000" and use one of the following neutralizations: Slow Factors, Fast Factors, Slow + Fast Factors, Crowding Factors, RAM.
"PV1" and "MODEL110" datasets are not allowed (except support fields).
Alphas that match the theme are eligible for Power Pool Thematic competition. Total stipend pool of up to USD 15,000:
  • 1st: $600
  • 2nd: $500
  • 3rd: $400
  • 4th-8th: $300 each
  • 9th-10th: $250 each
  • 11th15th: $200 each
  • 16th20th: $150 each
  • 21st30th: $125 each
  • 31st40th: $100 each

Learn more about Power Pool Alphas Thematic Competition:FAQ, Risk Neutralized Alphas, Risk Neutralization: Default setting, Crowding Risk-Neutralized Alphas, RAM Risk-Neutralized Alphas, Statistical Risk-Neutralized Alphas

results.title: Power Pool Alphas Thematic Competition June 2026 leaderboards
results.description:
Power Pool Alphas Thematic Competition June'26 leaderboards are out! Congratulations to all the top performers. Check out your score in “Power Pool Leaderboard” using the Board Name dropdown on the top right.

Reminder that the overall stipend pool of up to $15,000 across Power Pool Themes each month is distributed among 80 winners. The stipend pool for each Power Pool Theme in a month can vary based on its duration and its number of winners. Given two Power Pool Themes in June 2026 - USA/D1 Fast Datasets Power Pool June`26 and GLB/D1 Dataset Power Pool June`26, the stipend pool structure for each theme is:

  • 1st: $600
  • 2nd: $500

  • 4th-8th: $300 each
